answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one orchard plot. Each epoch a lottery audits one plot in twenty: it must post an ember-stamped proof on the jetty board in ten minutes, fresh from its plot key. A stale or copied proof burns the bond. Filing costs 44, the k-th fake 44+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,040,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-proof rings fail: one key, one plot, one proof. Honest tenders pay 44 once, keeping the bond.
